strings.name: Pope Leo XIV
strings.summary: Born Robert Francis Prevost in Chicago, Leo XIV studied mathematics, theology and canon law, served as missionary and bishop in Peru, then led the Vatican’s bishops office. Elected in 2025 as the first US-born pope, he addresses peace, humanitarian affairs and technology ethics. His past abuse-case handling faces scrutiny and praise from some survivors; no personal illegality is inferred.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Rose from transnational church service to Catholicism’s highest leadership; his religious and humanitarian affairs influence believers worldwide and public debate.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Villanova mathematics bachelor’s (1977); theology studies in Chicago; canon law doctorate, Angelicum, Rome.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Transnational church service
strings.highlights.h1.text: Pastoral and administrative work in the United States, Peru and Rome.
strings.highlights.h2.title: First US-born pope
strings.highlights.h2.text: Elected in 2025, taking the name Leo XIV.
strings.timeline.t1.title: African visit
strings.timeline.t1.text: Began an African journey including Algeria.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Elected pope
strings.timeline.t2.text: Chosen on 8 May as the 267th pope.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Vatican leadership
strings.timeline.t3.text: Appointed prefect of bishops and made cardinal that year.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Bishop of Chiclayo
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became diocesan bishop after serving as apostolic administrator.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Augustinian prior general
strings.timeline.t5.text: Elected head of the order; reelected in 2007.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Mission in Peru
strings.timeline.t6.text: Began Augustinian missionary work in Chulucanas.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Priestly ordination
strings.timeline.t8.title: Mathematics and religious life
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Villanova and entered the Augustinian novitiate.
